maddeler.e:
نستدفئ (form X)
# نَسْتَدْفِئُ (nastadfiʔu) /nas.tad.fi.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَدْفَأَ (istadfaʔa)
# نَسْتَدْفِئَ (nastadfiʔa) /nas.tad.fi.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَدْفَأَ (istadfaʔa)
# نَسْتَدْفِئْ (nastadfiʔ) /nas.tad.fiʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَدْفَأَ (istadfaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
